_metadata.description: Project the callable surface from the proto descriptor and CLI manifests, validate arguments pre-flight, refuse ungoverned calls, and render the resolved registry.

requirements.title: Runtime binding generation
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST generate callable bindings at session start from the proto descriptor image and the scenario CLI manifests, and MUST NOT require per-scenario integration code for a scenario that ships a manifest.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestProjectsManifestBoundMethods` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). Given the generated descriptor image and a scenario CLI manifest, the registry yields one callable per manifest-bound Connect method.

Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestNewManifestNeedsNoScenarioCode` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). A manifest added to the fixture set becomes callable without any registry edit, proving zero per-scenario integration.

Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_namespace_mirrors_manifest_groups` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). The kernel namespace path matches the manifest group/command shape agents already know from the CLI.

requirements.title: Pre-flight argument validation
requirements.description: When a program calls a binding with arguments that do not satisfy the bound proto method's field contract, the Program Runtime MUST reject the call before issuing any request and MUST name the offending field.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestRejectsUnknownFieldBeforeDispatch` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). An argument absent from the bound request message is refused with no outbound request issued.

Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestErrorNamesOffendingField` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). The refusal names the offending field so a program can be repaired without reading proto source.

Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestRejectsMistypedAndMissingRequiredFields` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). Wrong-typed and omitted required fields are refused pre-flight, not surfaced as a remote 400.

requirements.title: Governance enforced at the binding boundary
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST NOT generate a binding for a command whose CLI manifest governance declares run_eligible false, and MUST refuse a binding whose declared effect is destructive unless the session holds an explicit matching grant.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestRunIneligibleCommandGeneratesNoBinding` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). A manifest command declaring run_eligible false produces no callable at all, not a callable that fails at dispatch.

Target `api/internal/bindings/governance_test.go::TestDestructiveEffectRequiresGrant` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). A destructive-effect binding refuses without a matching session grant and succeeds with one.

Target `api/internal/bindings/governance_test.go::TestGovernanceIsReadNotRedefined` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). Effect and permission vocabulary is read from the manifest contract; the scenario declares no second policy vocabulary.

requirements.title: In-kernel capability discovery
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD expose capability discovery as an in-kernel call so a program resolves an operation by intent without the callable surface being preloaded into the submitting agent's context.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/discovery_test.go::TestResolvesOperationByIntent` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-001]). An intent string resolves to candidate bindings through search-hub without preloading the surface.

Target `api/internal/bindings/discovery_test.go::TestDegradesWhenSearchHubUnavailable` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-001]). An unreachable search-hub degrades to a stated reason; direct binding calls keep working.

requirements.title: Binding registry inspection surface
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD provide an operator surface that browses the resolved callable namespace and, for every fleet capability that is unbound, states which of the declared unbound reasons applies.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestEveryUnboundCapabilityCarriesAReason` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-007]). No capability is reported unbound without one of the closed set of unbound reasons; an unclassifiable capability is reported as such rather than omitted.

Target `ui/src/features/bindings/BindingRegistry.test.tsx::rendersBoundAndUnboundWithReasons` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-007]). The surface renders with an empty program corpus, proving it carries information before any program has run.
